notes.title: Patch 0.4.4
notes.notes:
Hi! ElJoka here!
Here’s what we achieved with this patch:

As some of you know, a few days ago I changed the system so you no longer need to keep the game open for the timer to run!
You can now close the game and wait out the 2-hour cooldown. Once you log back in, I recommend waiting about 1 minute before fishing.

The in-game timer display wasn’t matching real time, so here’s what I fixed:

Timer UI now matches real-world time.

Info tab updated to clearly state you don’t need the game open for the timer.

I also fixed a couple of achievements so they work as intended:

Achievement “Fast Reeler” now correctly triggers only when you catch a fish within the first 0.1 seconds of the catch window.

Achievement “Never Too Late” now correctly triggers only when you catch a fish within the last 0.1 seconds of the catch window.



I also wanted to give you a sneak peek at some new fish! 🐟
Here are 3 of the fish that will be available during the Halloween event. As you can see, event-exclusive fish will feature a special gem indicating which event they came from — for Halloween, I’ve chosen orange.

The event will include around 20–30 brand-new fish that will only be available during its ~2-week run. I’ll share all the spooky details soon!
